h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Houston with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Houston?
faqs.a: The court's cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each individual court — some Houston-area courts charge less or add a small school-zone fee. The TDLR-approved course itself is separate; ours is $28. Check your specific court's page for the exact amount.

faqs.q: Can I take the Houston defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. Once your court approves the request, you can take a TDLR-approved 6-hour course fully online and submit the certificate. Every Houston-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Bellaire / West U / Jersey Village, not Houston proper. Does that change anything?
faqs.a: The legal process is the same, but you deal with that city's court, not the City of Houston. Each enclave court has its own fee, request method, and deadline rules — open its page in the table above for specifics.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish the course?
faqs.a: Generally 90 days after the court approves your request. You must request the course by your appearance date first — don't pay the ticket, because paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does dismissing the ticket keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't be used against you or raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: Houston Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS to submit with your certificate. Court fee: $144.

courts.name: Baytown Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Bellaire Municipal Court
courts.note: Bellaire charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request at the clerk window or before the judge by your court date; insurance proof must be paper.

courts.name: Bunker Hill Municipal Court
courts.note: Bunker Hill Village (Memorial Dr) charges $144 ($169 school zone) plus a $10 DPS record fee — request in person by your appearance date; 90 days.

courts.name: Deer Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Deer Park rejects certificates without the Type 3A record — both must be turned in together. Court fee $144.

courts.name: El Lago Municipal Court
courts.note: El Lago (NASA/Clear Lake) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — submit a notarized request form in person, by mail, or online by your appearance date.

courts.name: Galena Park Municipal Court
courts.note: Galena Park (Ship Channel) takes DSC requests in person, by fax, or mail — call (713) 672-2556 for the fee before your court date.

courts.name: Hedwig Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Hedwig Village (I-10 Memorial) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request in person on or before your court date with a guilty/no-contest plea.

courts.name: Hilshire Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Hilshire Village's court runs through Spring Valley — $144 ($169 school zone), request in person by your court date; 90 days, Type 3A record.

courts.name: Humble Municipal Court
courts.note: Humble (US-59) charges $144 ($159 school zone) and gives 90 days — request in court, by mail, or at the court office, not the clerk window.

courts.name: Hunters Creek Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Hunters Creek Village (Memorial) approves the DSC by request — a fee is due on approval; 90 days, and a driving record filed with your certificate. Call (713) 465-5646.

courts.name: Jacinto City Municipal Court
courts.note: Jacinto City (I-10 East) hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (713) 674-8424 by your appearance date to confirm the amount and request process.

courts.name: Jersey Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Jersey Village (US-290) charges $144 ($169 school zone) and takes DSC requests in person, by email, or mail by your appearance date.

courts.name: Katy Municipal Court
courts.note: Katy's court fee is unusually low — $114 ($139 school zone) — but mail/online requests need a notarized affidavit.

courts.name: La Porte Municipal Court
courts.note: La Porte doesn't post DSC fees online — and paying your fine online counts as a conviction. Request DSC first.

courts.name: Morgans Point Municipal Court
courts.note: Morgan's Point (Harris County, near La Porte) hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (346) 222-7396 or email by your appearance date for the amount.

courts.name: Nassau Bay Municipal Court
courts.note: Nassau Bay (NASA/Clear Lake) asks you to contact the court directly for eligibility — email (preferred) or call (281) 336-6297 by your appearance date for the fee.

courts.name: Pasadena Municipal Court
courts.note: Pasadena charges $144 ($169 in a school zone) and takes requests by certified mail or in person by the court date on your ticket — no notary needed, just the unsworn declaration on the application.

courts.name: Piney Point Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Piney Point Village (Memorial) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request the DSC in writing before paying; pay online only after you're enrolled.

courts.name: Seabrook Municipal Court
courts.note: Seabrook (SH-146) takes DSC requests in person, by email (2 business days ahead), or online — sign via DropBox by 4 p.m. that day.

courts.name: Shoreacres Municipal Court
courts.note: Shoreacres consolidated into La Porte in 2026 — former Shoreacres citations are now handled by La Porte Municipal Court; confirm at (281) 471-4683.

courts.name: South Houston Municipal Court
courts.note: South Houston (its own court, not City of Houston) takes DSC requests in person at your arraignment — call (713) 947-7700 for the fee.

courts.name: Southside Place Municipal Court
courts.note: Southside Place (near West U) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request at the clerk's window by your court date; 90 days, Type 3A record.

courts.name: Spring Valley Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Spring Valley Village (I-10 Memorial) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — request court permission in person, then submit your certificate and Type 3A record by the due date.

courts.name: Taylor Lake Village Municipal Court
courts.note: Taylor Lake Village (Clear Lake) charges $144 ($169 school zone) — get court approval first, then present your certificate by day 90.

courts.name: Tomball Municipal Court
courts.note: Tomball (SH-249) charges $144 ($169 school zone) and takes DSC requests in person, online, or by notarized mail by your answer date.

courts.name: Webster Municipal Court
courts.note: Webster (I-45/NASA) charges $144 ($169 school zone) and takes DSC requests in person or through its online form before your court date.

courts.name: West University Place Municipal Court
courts.note: West U charges $144 ($169 school zone) — give written notice by your court date in person or by email; 90 days to finish.
